name: Tahan
overview: Tahan is a male descendant of the tribe of Ephraim, noted specifically as a son of Ephraim according to Numbers 26:35. He is recognized as the ancestor of the Tahanites, a family group within the Ephraim tribe. This identification situates him within the genealogical records of Israel during the wilderness period.
namesAndTitles: The name Tahan, as recorded in Numbers 26:35, possibly means 'grace' or 'favor.' It is a proper name but is not indicated as being given directly by God. This meaning may reflect a positive attribute associated with his lineage.
familyAndRelationships: Scripture explicitly records Tahan as a son of Ephraim, establishing his place within the Ephraimite family line. Beyond this, no additional family relationships are detailed in the biblical text.
scriptureSignificance: Tahan's significance lies in his role as the progenitor of the Tahanites, a named family group within the tribe of Ephraim. His mention in the genealogical census of Numbers highlights the importance of tribal and familial identities in Israel's organization. While not a prominent narrative figure, Tahan contributes to the preservation of Israel's tribal heritage as recorded in Scripture.
